landing.speed.body: 100 points for a correct answer, plus a speed bonus of up to 60 that drains to zero at the buzzer.

landing.step1.title: Send a code
landing.step2.body: The same questions in the same order, twenty seconds each. Whoever plays first waits, and the notification is the game.
landing.step2.title: Play whenever you like
landing.step3.body: Half the rays are yours and half are theirs, one per question. You only see their answers once your own run is finished.
landing.step3.title: The star completes
